name: datadeck
description: DataDeck: XLSX/CSV multi-view plugin for Obsidian

scripts.deploy: cp main.js styles.css manifest.json datadeck/ && cp main.js styles.css manifest.json datadeck-work/
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy
scripts.test:all: node test-csv-parser.mjs && node test-plugin-logic.mjs && node test-view-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run lint && npm run build:deploy
